annotations.title: Cancel a booking (free, at least 48 h before; customer confirms by email code)

description: Cancels an existing home-cleaning booking free of charge when the visit is at least 48 hours away (terms, article 7.4). Two calls: 1) without verification_code - checks the request and emails a 6-digit code to the address on the booking; 2) ask the customer for the code and call again with the same arguments plus verification_code. Recurring plans: scope "visit" cancels one visit (with visit_date), scope "plan" stops all upcoming visits (visits less than 48 hours away stay scheduled). Less than 48 hours before, or for an already-paid booking: use send_message or call 01 89 19 68 69.

email.description: Email address used for the booking

scope.description: booking = one-off booking (default); visit = one visit of a recurring plan; plan = stop the recurring plan

verification_code.description: 6-digit code from the email, second call only

visit_date.description: With scope=visit: date of the visit to cancel
